SQLite 3.54.1

Source: https://github.com/sqlite/sqlite/tree/version-3.54.1
License: public domain. SQLite's original blessing and source notices remain
in sqlite3.c and sqlite3.h. SQLite is a separate third-party C dependency.

The source was generated locally from the official tag using its C and Tcl
build tools. The amalgamation was then split with its split-sqlite3c.tcl tool.
That tool's chunk target was set to 4000 lines, its output filenames use
sqlitePartNNN.c, and its Tcl output translation was changed from the invalid
value 'text' to 'binary'. SQLite's C implementation was not edited. sqlite3.c
includes these required parts as one translation unit. Do not compile the
parts separately. The build tools are not included in this project.
This is not a claim that the output matches the official download byte for byte.

Original generated source SHA-256, before splitting:
sqlite3.c 724438b6f33e748be738a3e196e60786e3e00f48bc7f52d64d7a3a53bd9c94ce
sqlite3.h 59114192eef65d9428279ec4a4a433631f50d3ca20c202acdd49d2a6bb94fb39

sourceChecksums.txt lists the hashes of the distributed split files.

Build options: SQLITE_ENABLE_FTS5, SQLITE_THREADSAFE=0,
SQLITE_OMIT_LOAD_EXTENSION. CardClarity uses SQLite on its one UI thread.
No loadable extensions or database server are needed. SQL is query text
passed to SQLite's C API; the application and test programs are written in C.
